neighbours.label: word-internal pieces of long derived Russian words (participles and abstract nouns such as протестующие, разногласий, выступающие), as against the same content in English
fire: Вчера протестующие студенты собрались у здания мэрии.
Разногласия между министрами затянули обсуждение бюджета.
Выступающие на конференции говорили о климате.
Посетив выставку, школьники написали короткие сочинения.
quiet: Yesterday the protesting students gathered outside city hall.
Disagreements among the ministers delayed the budget debate.
The speakers at the conference talked about the climate.
After visiting the exhibition, the pupils wrote short essays.
The astonished audience applauded the orchestra for a long time.
The management maliciously ignored the workers' complaints.
The participating teams received commemorative medals.

predictions: fire 0.5-0.9 on inner pieces of long Russian words; English translations below 0.1
notes: Card: peaks on mid-word Cyrillic pieces ('ост', 'ет', 'лас', 'ест', 'ступ') in Russian news, with some Korean and Japanese. Probe: Протестующие 0.536, Посетив 0.710, злостно 0.752, разногласий 0.885, Выступающие 0.660, Изумленный 0.515; short Russian words 'купили хлеб' 0.258, 'солнечно' 0.305; English 'The protesters left' 0.033. Short Russian sentences fire about 0.3, so near misses are English translations of the same fire content; this tests Cyrillic subwords, not the derivation.
